name: Wilnsdorf (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, yellow and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Wilnsdorf (a lion on yellow above a chequy base).
history: Municipal flag of Wilnsdorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
